note: Conceptual lesson on general architecture-diagramming practice (context diagrams, system landscape diagrams, data flow diagrams) applied to a Salesforce-in-the-enterprise context. This is general architecture-communication practice, not a Salesforce-specific feature claim, so no vendor documentation citation is required. No screenshot is used per this course's conceptual/architecture screenshot policy -- the lesson's Lab asks the student to sketch their own diagram rather than reproducing a vendor screenshot.
